name: css-modules-devtools
description: Completion, go-to-definition, hover, diagnostics and color swatches for CSS Modules and CSS variables.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces, workspace values of `globalFiles`, `pathAlias` and `nodeModules.enabled` are ignored because they can point the language server at files outside the workspace.

cssModulesDevTools.tsx.enabled.markdownDescription: Class features in TS/JS files. `auto` turns them off when css-modules-kit's TS plugin is active (TypeScript < 7).

cssModulesDevTools.completion.enabled.description: Class name completion in TS/JS files and in `composes`.

cssModulesDevTools.definition.enabled.description: Go to definition for classes, `composes` and `var()`.

cssModulesDevTools.hover.enabled.description: Hover preview of CSS rules and variables.

cssModulesDevTools.hover.maxLines.description: Maximum lines shown in a hover preview.

cssModulesDevTools.autoImport.enabled.markdownDescription: Suggest nearby CSS modules when typing an unimported binding listed in `#cssModulesDevTools.autoImport.identifiers#` (e.g. `styles.`). Path style follows `typescript.preferences.importModuleSpecifier`.

cssModulesDevTools.autoImport.identifier.markdownDescription: Identifiers that trigger auto-import when typed unimported, e.g. `styles.`. Other unbound names (`expect.`, `Buffer.`) never do. An empty list turns auto-import off.

cssModulesDevTools.variables.tsxStrings.markdownDescription: Complete `var(--*)` inside strings in TS/JS files.

cssModulesDevTools.variables.colors.markdownDescription: Show color swatches on `var(--*)` usages that resolve to a color.

cssModulesDevTools.classNameConvention.markdownDescription: How class names map to keys. Mirrors css-loader's `exportLocalsConvention`.

cssModulesDevTools.pathAlias.markdownDescription: Alias overrides checked before tsconfig `paths`, e.g. `{ "@styles": "${workspaceFolder}/src/styles" }`. Supports `${workspaceFolder}` and `${packageRoot}`. Falls back to `cssModules.pathAlias`.

cssModulesDevTools.globalFiles.markdownDescription: Globs (relative to each package root) of stylesheets whose variables and classes are global, e.g. `src/app/globals.css`. Their `@import`s are followed. Falls back to `cssVariables.lookupFiles` when that is set explicitly.

cssModulesDevTools.varShadow.maxDepth.markdownDescription: Flag redeclared global variables only in rules nested at most this deep (0 = top-level rules, -1 = any depth).
